description.value: A small boutique winery on the northern edge of the Great Basin Desert near Oliver, producing about 18,000 bottles per year. Wines are aged in a unique underground cellar overlooked by the namesake hidden chapel, and the tasting room is set among pines and gardens. Located only 5 km outside Oliver and 3 km from the District Wine Village, making it a feasible side trip for cyclists touring the South Okanagan wine country.
